observations: White game console with a three-tier design, characteristic of a PS4 Pro.
Sony PlayStation logo is visible on the top surface.
Two boxed controllers; boxes labeled 'Wireless Controller' and 'FOR Switch/P4/P3/PC'.
One UK-plug power cable and one black USB or HDMI cable.
Watermark 'GAME ARENAOFFICAL' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' present on the image.
The console exterior appears clean with no obvious cracks.

claims.evidence: The three-tier chassis in photo 0 is unique to the PS4 Pro model.
Requires a clear photo of the warranty seals on the rear of the console.
Photo 0 shows third-party controller boxes labeled for multiple platforms (Switch/P4/P3/PC), which are not original Sony DualShock 4 packaging.
The receipt is mentioned but not shown in the photos.

risks.proof: A close-up photo of the factory warranty seals over the screws on the back.
Photo 0 already shows third-party boxes; assume controllers are non-original.
A photo or video of the console successfully logged into a PSN account.
A video showing a game disc being inserted, recognized, and launched.

proof_requests: Photo of the warranty seals on the back of the console.
Photo of the UK receipt mentioned in the description.
Video of the console running a game from a disc and connected to PSN.
Clear photos of the controllers out of their boxes to verify their condition and brand.
response.reason: The seller claims the item comes with 'original pads', but the photo clearly shows third-party controller boxes. This contradiction, along with the presence of a business watermark while claiming a personal 'UK receipt', makes the listing's authenticity questionable. Proof of the warranty seals and the receipt is required before a reliable price can be set.
